name: Noto Hanto Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Noto Peninsula with its ria coast, the Wajima and Sosogi terraced fields, and the century-old mountain villages of the peninsula.
notes: Managed by Ishikawa/Toyama. The Noto Kongo coast and the peninsula loop road are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
